notes.title: Update Fix v1.3.0.1200
notes.notes:
Fixed. The ball could endlessly fly along a single trajectory.
Fixed. After changing the localization, the text was not always updated.
Fixed. The counter displayed fractional numbers.

If you like the game, please write here!
I think to release the second part of the games, it will be even more interesting. 
Enjoy the game!

You can also watch my YouTube channel.
https://www.youtube.com/c/wenrexa

notes.title: Update v1.2.0.1120
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34514590/73ceff91182954e7187929b691b1e018bf9efdf4.jpg
The game has been recreated. 
Change. The design of the blocks.
Change. Design (boards).
Change. Design (ball, fir cones).
Change. Game menu design and GUI in General.
Added. Ability to change the design of the Board and the ball.
Added. The game menu can be called during the game.
Added. Resource crystals (you can spend in the store).
Corrected. Pausing the game did not work correctly and could block the game forever.
Corrected. The settings were saved, but the game did not load them correctly.
Corrected. The ball could hang in the air and it could not be moved.
Corrected. Error in the memory calculation, the unknown values of 0.12 and 0.15 has caused the game to crash.
Remote. Insects that crawled across the screen and interfered with the game.
Optimization. Resolution of all graphics objects.
